```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

# Read open and resolved issues (fall back to issues.csv if split files don't exist yet)
if (file.exists(here("data", "clean", "issues_open.csv"))) {
  issues_open <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "issues_open.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  issues_open <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "issues.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
}

if (file.exists(here("data", "clean", "issues_resolved.csv"))) {
  issues_resolved <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "issues_resolved.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  issues_resolved <- tibble()
}

# Build slugs
issues_open <- issues_open |>
  mutate(
    slug = school_name |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |> str_remove("-$"),
    visit_date = as.character(visit_date)
  )

if (nrow(issues_resolved) > 0) {
  issues_resolved <- issues_resolved |>
    mutate(
      slug = school_name |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |> str_remove("-$"),
      visit_date = as.character(visit_date),
      resolved_date = as.character(resolved_date)
    )
}

# Build JSON for client-side
open_json <- toJSON(issues_open, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
resolved_json <- toJSON(issues_resolved, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

htmltools::HTML(paste0(
'<!-- Open Issues -->
<h2>Open Issues</h2>
<p style="color:#666; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:1rem;">Urgent issues flagged during field visits. Click <strong>Resolve</strong> to mark an issue as addressed.</p>
<div id="open-issues-container"></div>

<!-- Resolved Issues -->
<h2>Resolved Issues</h2>
<div id="resolved-issues-container"></div>

<!-- Resolve Modal -->
<div id="resolve-modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeResolveModal()" style="display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index:9999; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
  <div style="background:#fff; border-radius:12px; padding:2rem; max-width:480px; width:90%; box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">
    <h3 style="color:var(--epi-navy); margin-top:0; margin-bottom:0.5rem;">Resolve Issue</h3>
    <p id="resolve-modal-school" style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); margin-bottom:0.25rem;"></p>
    <p id="resolve-modal-issue" style="color:#555; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; padding:0.75rem; background:#f8f9fa; border-radius:4px; border-left:3px solid #dc3545;"></p>
    <div style="margin-bottom:1rem;">
      <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.85rem; display:block; margin-bottom:0.35rem;">Your Name *</label>
      <input type="text" id="resolve-by" placeholder="e.g. Richard" style="width:100%; padding:0.5rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; font-size:0.9rem; box-sizing:border-box;">
    </div>
    <div style="margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
      <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.85rem; display:block; margin-bottom:0.35rem;">Resolution Notes (optional)</label>
      <textarea id="resolve-notes" rows="3" placeholder="What was done to address this issue?" style="width:100%; padding:0.5rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; font-size:0.9rem; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;"></textarea>
    </div>
    <div id="resolve-error" style="display:none; color:#dc3545; font-size:0.85rem; margin-bottom:0.75rem;"></div>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:0.75rem; justify-content:flex-end;">
      <button onclick="closeResolveModal()" style="background:#e9ecef; color:#333; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:0.5rem 1.25rem; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button>
      <button id="btn-confirm-resolve" onclick="submitResolve()" style="background:#28a745; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:0.5rem 1.25rem; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">Confirm Resolution</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
var OPEN_ISSUES = ', open_json, ';
var RESOLVED_ISSUES = ', resolved_json, ';
var currentResolveIssue = null;

function makeIssueCard(issue, isResolved) {
  var border = isResolved ? "border-left:4px solid #28a745;" : "border-left:4px solid #dc3545;";
  var html = \'<div id="issue-\' + issue.issue_id + \'" style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1rem; \' + border + \'">\';
  html += \'<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:0.5rem;">\';
  html += \'<a href="schools.html?school=\' + (issue.slug || "") + \'" style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--epi-navy);">\' + issue.school_name + \'</a>\';
  var meta = (issue.visit_date || "");
  if (issue.visitor) meta += " &middot; " + issue.visitor;
  html += \'<span style="color:#999; font-size:0.8rem;">\' + meta + \'</span>\';
  html += \'</div>\';

  if (isResolved) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0.25rem 0 0; color:#999; text-decoration:line-through;">\' + issue.urgent_issues + \'</p>\';
    html += \'<details style="margin-top:0.5rem;"><summary style="cursor:pointer; font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--epi-navy); font-weight:600;">Resolution details</summary>\';
    html += \'<div style="margin-top:0.5rem; padding:0.75rem; background:#f0faf0; border-radius:4px; font-size:0.85rem;">\';
    html += \'<p style="margin:0 0 0.25rem;"><strong>Resolved by:</strong> \' + (issue.resolved_by || "—") + \' on \' + (issue.resolved_date || "—") + \'</p>\';
    if (issue.resolution_notes) {
      html += \'<p style="margin:0;"><strong>Notes:</strong> \' + issue.resolution_notes + \'</p>\';
    }
    html += \'</div></details>\';
  } else {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0.25rem 0 0; color:#333;">\' + issue.urgent_issues + \'</p>\';
    if (issue.visit_reason && issue.visit_reason !== "null") {
      html += \'<p style="font-size:0.8rem; margin:0.25rem 0 0; color:#999;">Visit reason: \' + issue.visit_reason + \'</p>\';
    }
    html += \'<button class="btn-resolve" onclick="openResolveModal(\\\'\' + issue.issue_id + \'\\\')">Resolve</button>\';
  }

  html += \'</div>\';
  return html;
}

function sortByDateDesc(a, b) {
  var da = a.visit_date || "";
  var db = b.visit_date || "";
  if (da !== db) return db.localeCompare(da);
  return (a.school_name || "").localeCompare(b.school_name || "");
}

function renderIssues() {
  var openHtml = "";
  if (OPEN_ISSUES.length === 0) {
    openHtml = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);"><p style="color:#28a745; font-weight:600; margin:0;">All issues have been resolved!</p></div>\';
  } else {
    OPEN_ISSUES.slice().sort(sortByDateDesc).forEach(function(issue) {
      openHtml += makeIssueCard(issue, false);
    });
  }
  document.getElementById("open-issues-container").innerHTML = openHtml;

  var resolvedHtml = "";
  if (RESOLVED_ISSUES.length === 0) {
    resolvedHtml = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);"><p style="color:#999; font-style:italic; margin:0;">No resolved issues yet.</p></div>\';
  } else {
    RESOLVED_ISSUES.slice().sort(sortByDateDesc).forEach(function(issue) {
      resolvedHtml += makeIssueCard(issue, true);
    });
  }
  document.getElementById("resolved-issues-container").innerHTML = resolvedHtml;

  document.getElementById("stat-open").textContent = OPEN_ISSUES.length;
  document.getElementById("stat-resolved").textContent = RESOLVED_ISSUES.length;
}

function openResolveModal(issueId) {
  currentResolveIssue = OPEN_ISSUES.find(function(i) { return i.issue_id === issueId; });
  if (!currentResolveIssue) return;
  document.getElementById("resolve-modal-school").textContent = currentResolveIssue.school_name;
  document.getElementById("resolve-modal-issue").textContent = currentResolveIssue.urgent_issues;
  document.getElementById("resolve-by").value = "";
  document.getElementById("resolve-notes").value = "";
  document.getElementById("resolve-error").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("btn-confirm-resolve").disabled = false;
  document.getElementById("btn-confirm-resolve").textContent = "Confirm Resolution";
  document.getElementById("resolve-modal").style.display = "flex";
}

function closeResolveModal() {
  document.getElementById("resolve-modal").style.display = "none";
  currentResolveIssue = null;
}

async function submitResolve() {
  if (!currentResolveIssue) return;
  var resolvedBy = document.getElementById("resolve-by").value.trim();
  if (!resolvedBy) {
    var errDiv = document.getElementById("resolve-error");
    errDiv.textContent = "Please enter your name.";
    errDiv.style.display = "block";
    return;
  }

  var btn = document.getElementById("btn-confirm-resolve");
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = "Submitting...";
  document.getElementById("resolve-error").style.display = "none";

  try {
    var resp = await fetch("/api/resolve-issue", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        issue_id: currentResolveIssue.issue_id,
        school_name: currentResolveIssue.school_name,
        issue_text: currentResolveIssue.urgent_issues,
        visit_date: currentResolveIssue.visit_date,
        resolved_by: resolvedBy,
        resolution_notes: document.getElementById("resolve-notes").value.trim()
      })
    });
    var data = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || data.error) {
      throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to resolve issue");
    }

    // Move issue from open to resolved
    var resolved = Object.assign({}, currentResolveIssue, {
      resolved_by: resolvedBy,
      resolved_date: data.resolved_date,
      resolution_notes: document.getElementById("resolve-notes").value.trim()
    });
    OPEN_ISSUES = OPEN_ISSUES.filter(function(i) { return i.issue_id !== currentResolveIssue.issue_id; });
    RESOLVED_ISSUES.unshift(resolved);

    closeResolveModal();
    renderIssues();
  } catch (err) {
    var errDiv = document.getElementById("resolve-error");
    errDiv.textContent = "Error: " + err.message;
    errDiv.style.display = "block";
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = "Confirm Resolution";
  }
}

// Initial render
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderIssues);
</script>
'))
```
